plan.title: TelegramTUI (tg-tui) v1.0.0 Production Deployment & Stability
plan.summary: Deployment of a lightweight (<25MB RAM), 100% keyboard-driven terminal Telegram client in Rust to developers and sysadmins as a daily driver replacement for the official client.
plan.decision: Ship v1.0.0 publicly on GitHub with prebuilt Windows/Linux binaries, claim production stability, and recommend it as an everyday chat tool.

assumptions.statement: Crossterm and Ratatui will handle all terminal resize events, panics, signal interrupts, and Unicode without corrupting the user's terminal or crashing.
The client will stay strictly under 25MB RAM in continuous long-running daily usage without memory leaks or unbounded growth.
The Tokio async event loop and Crossterm input polling will maintain snappy, latency-free (<16ms) typing without keystroke drops under load.
Message history viewport and scrolling logic will naturally present conversations so incoming updates and navigation are immediately visible.
The client will gracefully handle network dropouts, sleep/wake cycles, and MTProto reconnection without silent message loss.
Notification bells and alerts will not cause visual tearing or acoustic spam during high-volume channel activity.
The single-line composer widget is sufficient for real-world messages without clipping, text overflow, or editing frustration.

failure_modes.title: Terminal State Corruption & Shell Lockout on Panic
failure_modes.story: A user resized their terminal or encountered unexpected Unicode text; a panic occurred during drawing before raw mode and alternate screen were cleaned up; the user's shell was left broken with invisible cursor and no line echo, forcing them to kill the terminal session.
failure_modes.indicator: GitHub issues reporting 'terminal frozen', 'broken cursor', or 'blank screen after crash'
failure_modes.response: Immediately deploy panic hook restoring terminal raw mode and printing human-readable crash log
failure_modes.mitigation: Install std::panic::set_hook in main.rs to catch any unhandled panic, execute disable_raw_mode() and LeaveAlternateScreen, and flush stdout before exiting.

failure_modes.title: Message History Autoscroll Blindness
failure_modes.story: Users with active chats (>30 messages) found the history viewport fixed to the top (oldest messages) because no auto-scroll to bottom or dynamic viewport follow was implemented; new incoming messages arrived off-screen, leading users to believe the client stopped working.
failure_modes.indicator: User bug reports stating 'chat does not show new messages' or 'cannot scroll down to bottom'
failure_modes.threshold: >= 2 user complaints within 7 days of launch
failure_modes.response: Implement dedicated ScrollState tracking in messages panel with default pin-to-bottom and j/k cursor synchronization
failure_modes.mitigation: Calculate total wrapped message lines against available viewport height, anchor scroll offset to bottom by default, and clamp selection cursor within visible viewport.

failure_modes.title: Long-Running Session Memory Leak from Unbounded Vectors
failure_modes.story: Power users leaving tg-tui in a background tmux session for multiple weeks found RAM usage ballooning past 800MB due to unbounded push() of all incoming channel messages into memory, completely violating the <25MB RAM pledge.
failure_modes.indicator: Process RSS memory exceeding 50MB after 72 hours of idle background operation
failure_modes.response: Evict older messages from memory and stream them to local SQLite database with sliding window of 100 messages per chat
failure_modes.mitigation: Cap in-memory message history to 100 messages per active chat, offloading older history to schema.sql SQLite storage and paginating on scroll-up.

failure_modes.title: Composer Text Clipping & Overflow on Long Messages
failure_modes.story: Users typing long messages, URLs, or code snippets found text overflowing the right border without horizontal scrolling or word wrapping; cursor and typed text became invisible, preventing editing or verification before sending.
failure_modes.indicator: User complaints regarding truncated input or inability to review long text in composer
failure_modes.response: Add horizontal viewport scroll offset and multi-line word-wrap expansion to composer widget
failure_modes.mitigation: Add scroll_offset_x calculation to composer Paragraph and integrate unicode-segmentation grapheme cluster navigation.

failure_modes.title: Input Stutter & Dropped Keystrokes Under Network Load
failure_modes.story: During bulk message sync or channel updates, the main event loop prioritized TDLib channel processing over keyboard polling, causing perceptible lag when typing quickly.
failure_modes.indicator: Measured input latency > 50ms during heavy network traffic benchmark
failure_modes.response: Decouple crossterm input reading into dedicated blocking Tokio task sending events through unbounded mpsc channel
failure_modes.mitigation: Move event::read() into a dedicated background input thread and use tokio::select! biased mode to always prioritize user keystrokes over background sync.

failure_modes.title: Terminal Redraw Tearing from Raw Bell Character
failure_modes.story: In high-traffic groups, direct raw print!('\x07') to stdout bypassed Ratatui's double-buffering, causing terminal cell tearing, displaced borders, and relentless audio screeching.
failure_modes.indicator: User reports of visual glitches in terminal frame or loud bell spam in busy groups
failure_modes.response: Throttle notification beeps to max 1 per 5 seconds and route through configuration toggle
failure_modes.mitigation: Add notification_bell boolean in AppConfig, throttle bell trigger to once per 5 seconds, and avoid raw unbuffered stdout prints during render frames.

failure_modes.title: Silent Message Drop on Network Disconnect
failure_modes.story: Users pressed Enter on messages while laptop WiFi temporarily dropped; messages remained stuck in pending state without clear offline indicator or retry queue, leaving users unaware their messages were never transmitted.
failure_modes.indicator: Messages stuck in DeliveryStatus::Pending for > 30 seconds without retry
failure_modes.threshold: Pending duration > 15s when network is degraded
failure_modes.response: Show prominent [Offline - Reconnecting...] banner in header and implement persistent SQLite outbox queue
failure_modes.mitigation: Add ConnectionState enum to coordinator, render network status banner in UI, and queue unacknowledged messages in an Outbox with exponential backoff retry.

residual_risk: External TDLib shared library binary dependency across diverse Linux distributions (glibc vs musl differences on custom kernels) and edge-case terminal emulator escape code differences on legacy Windows conhost.
